description: This file defines an event listener that responds to successful authentication events within a Spring Security context. It updates user failure attempt counts via UserService when a login succeeds.

classes.name: AuthenticationSuccessListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for successful authentication events to reset failed login attempts for the user.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles AuthenticationSuccessEvent; retrieves user by email and resets failure attempts if necessary.
